checks.name: One shared heading and outer geometry writer
One root click binding, no legacy root insertion
Registry evaluated, unique, frozen and complete

Button.contract: semantic button, type, accessible name, focus-visible, disabled

Input.contract: label, input type, composition, error description

SearchField.contract: query state belongs to scoped search, not root navigation

ListItem.contract: one explicit resource ID and action

Avatar.contract: decorative initials or meaningful image alt

Card.contract: content owns local actions, never root shell

Modal.contract: native dialog, label, initial focus, escape, focus return

Sheet.contract: bounded history entry, leave consent, focus return

Toast.contract: status, finite lifetime, no secret text

ErrorState.contract: visible error and explicit retry; never fake success

AgentTaskCard.contract: runId, initiator, status, cancel action; no executor

PrivateAgentResult.contract: resultId, scope, provenance, authorized actions; private by default

ActionConfirmation.contract: exact action, parameters, revision, expiry; explicit confirm/cancel

WorkObjectPreview.contract: objectId, revision, source, permitted actions; object is not message

SidePanel.contract: desktop object surface; same object/route as FullScreenObjectView

FullScreenObjectView.contract: mobile object surface, close guard, focus return, same object/route as SidePanel

composer.note: Existing v1 draft/IndexedDB remains canonical. Future adapters validate context and permission before execution; declarations do not grant capabilities.

calls.surface: Non-root session overlay; independent from editor/list resource. Mobile full screen and desktop panel share session ID.
